description: SSOT for all motion (animation duration and easing) token values. No other document defines these values. See PROP-2026-001.

TK-motion-duration-instant.role: Instant — no animation, immediate state change

TK-motion-duration-fast.role: Fast — hover transitions, micro-interactions, icon changes

TK-motion-duration-slow.role: Slow — page transitions, modal open/close, complex animations

TK-motion-easing-in.role: Ease-in — elements entering the viewport, appearing

TK-motion-easing-out.role: Ease-out — elements leaving the viewport, disappearing
